name: File Island
corpus: TFT Set 1: Faction Wars (56 of its 57 champions) plus 4 Dota Auto Chess pieces that are not in Underlords
theme: The current game. The original Digi-Destined partners, Tamers, Savers, Frontier and Xros Wars lines with the Royal Knights and Demon Lords at 5 cost. TFT Set 1 was the base game with Runeterra factions and classes; this set is the base game with Digimon families and roles.

mechanic.name: Data Wisps
mechanic.adapts: Wisps (TFT Set 18); TFT Set 1 had no set mechanic beyond the core loop
rules: Already built (see README.md "Rules"): every other round from stage 2 a one-use Wisp sits in the sixth shop slot; 7 categories; unbought Wisps leave at the end of the round.
mechanic.engineWork: None. Later sets switch Wisps off and use their own mechanic.

traits.name: Dragon's Roar
traits.desc: Dragon's Roar Digimon gain max HP.

traits.name: Nature Spirits
traits.desc: Nature Spirits gain attack speed.

traits.name: Jungle Troopers
traits.desc: Jungle Troopers regenerate max HP every second.
traits.adapts: none in Set 1 (regeneration; closest is Set 4 Elderwood)

traits.name: Wind Guardians
traits.desc: All allies gain a chance to dodge basic attacks.

traits.name: Deep Savers
traits.desc: Deep Savers start combat with a shield.
traits.adapts: none in Set 1 (shield; closest is Set 4 Keeper)

traits.name: Metal Empire
traits.desc: Metal Empire Digimon take less damage.

traits.name: Nightmare Soldiers
traits.desc: Nightmare Soldiers heal for a share of all damage they deal.
traits.adapts: none in Set 1 (omnivamp; closest is Set 7 Ragewing)

traits.name: Virus Busters
traits.desc: All allies start combat with bonus mana.

traits.name: Demon Lords
traits.desc: Demon Lords gain ability power. With 2 they deal more damage, and with 3 their abilities also burn.

traits.name: Royal Knights
traits.desc: Royal Knights gain damage and max HP for every active trait on your team, this one included.

traits.name: DATS
traits.desc: DigiSoul Charge: the first time an ally is knocked out, or after 10 seconds, DATS Digimon heal and gain attack damage and ability power.

traits.name: Legendary Warriors
traits.desc: Spirit Evolution (Agunimon and Lobomon): the first time a Legendary Warrior drops below 50% HP, it heals and fights harder for the rest of combat.

traits.name: Xros Fusion
traits.desc: DigiXros: at the start of combat, each Xros Fusion Digimon adds a share of the other Xros Fusion Digimon's max HP and attack damage to its own.
traits.adapts: none in Set 1 (Digimon-native; closest is Set 7 Guild)

traits.name: Insectoid
traits.desc: Every 2 seconds a swarm bites random enemies for magic damage. A bitten enemy misses its next basic attack.

traits.name: Pranksters
traits.desc: Every second basic attack of a Prankster throws muck: the target deals less damage for 3 seconds. You also gain gold after every combat.

traits.name: Knight Order
traits.desc: Knights take less damage. A Knight standing next to another Knight takes that much less again.

traits.name: Flame
traits.desc: Flame Digimon's abilities burn their targets for 1.5% max HP per second and cut their healing by a third for 5 seconds. Flame Digimon deal more damage to burning enemies.

traits.name: Frost
traits.desc: Frost Digimon's basic attacks have a chance to freeze the target for 1 second.

traits.name: Undead
traits.desc: The first time an Undead Digimon would be knocked out, it stays at 1 HP and can't be hurt for 1 second, then heals.

traits.name: Holy Beasts
traits.desc: All allies gain armor, magic resist and ability power. Holy Beasts gain double.

traits.name: Fallen Angels
traits.desc: All enemies lose armor and magic resist.

traits.name: Guardian
traits.desc: Guardians gain armor and magic resist.

traits.name: Striker
traits.desc: Strikers gain attack damage.
traits.adapts: none (flat AD; closest is Set 7 Warrior)

traits.name: Sniper
traits.desc: Snipers deal more damage for each hex between them and their target.

traits.name: Mystic
traits.desc: Mystics gain ability power.

traits.name: Assassin
traits.desc: Assassins always leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. The trait grants critical strike chance (160% damage).

traits.name: Bruiser
traits.desc: Bruisers gain max HP.

traits.name: Duelist
traits.desc: Each basic attack gives a Duelist attack speed, stacking up to 12 times.

traits.name: Support
traits.desc: Your team's healing is stronger. Every 4 seconds, each Support heals the lowest-health ally.
